texts.preamble: Nitesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh Thrugh Food ... on 9 September, 2022 Author: Rajendra Kumar Verma Bench: Rajendra Kumar Verma 1 In The High Court Of Madhya Pra At Indore Crr No. 3287 of (Nitesh Vs The State Of Madhya Pr Dated : 09-09-2022
texts.arguments: In support of his contention, counsel 2 reliance over the judgment of this Court pas Learned Government Advocate for the re hand, has opposed the bail application by submitting that no sufficient ground is made out for releasing the applicant on bail, both the courts below have convicted the petitioner rightly after considering the material available on record, hence the application filed by the applicant be dismissed.
texts.petitioner_arguments: In support of his contention, counsel 2 reliance over the judgment of this Court pas Learned Government Advocate for the re hand, has opposed the bail application by submitting that no sufficient ground is made out for releasing the applicant on bail, both the courts below have convicted the petitioner rightly after considering the material available on record, hence the application filed by the applicant be dismissed.
